blocks.text: Haggai 1 contains 15 verses. It opens with: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of Jehovah by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying, It concludes with: in the four and twentieth day of the month, in the sixth `month', in the second year of Darius the king.
